question: Should exec/process/node-host tool results redact secret-shaped output by default before the agent sees it, even when that changes byte-exact command output?
rationale: The implementation covers the reviewed result surfaces, but the default behavior changes both sensitive-output exposure and compatibility for workflows expecting raw command output.

options.title: Accept default redaction
options.body: Merge after security owner acceptance that secret-shaped command output is redacted before agent delivery.

options.title: Require reveal control
options.body: Keep the PR open until it adds a documented, tested, auditable raw-output reveal path for byte-exact workflows.

options.title: Choose marker-first design
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the generic redaction-marker contract from the related marker issue to land before changing this boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept default redaction
recommendation.body: Merge after security owner acceptance that secret-shaped command output is redacted before agent delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest combined history on exec/process runtime surfaces and is already the named decision target in the PR discussion.
